Game Overview

At its heart, Mr Flap is a animal game about guide a pixelated bird through rotating challenges in a deceptively simple circle. Click to soar past walls, test your reflexes, and strive for high scores. Endless fun and frustration await as you push your skills to the limit in this addictive arcade experience.
